# Course Frame

## Subject Overview {.theory-slide}

::: {.theory-card}
### Focus

This course connects service demand, technical design, regulation, and economic feasibility in telecommunication infrastructure planning.

### Core lens

- Translate needs into requirements.
- Dimension access and transport layers.
- Evaluate cost, energy, and regulation.
- Defend deployment decisions in realistic scenarios.
:::

## Why It Matters {.use-case-slide}

::: {.use-case-card}
### Reference use case

An operator must decide how to deploy connectivity in a mixed territory with dense urban demand, rural gaps, and mobility corridors.

### Questions to answer

- Which access technology best fits each area?
- How much capacity is required?
- What transport solution is viable?
- Is the business case sustainable?
:::
